metrics.rationale: User states '尽可能完整地接收 1530–1565 nm 电信波段的单光子信号' (receive 1530-1565 nm telecom band single-photon signals as completely as possible), requiring maximum transmittance in this signal band.
User states '尽可能反射 400–700 nm 波段的可见光太阳背景' (reflect 400-700 nm visible light solar background as much as possible), requiring maximum reflectance in this background rejection band.

standard.metric_rationale: These two metrics directly encode the dual-band spectral separation requirement: high transmission for quantum signal reception (1530-1565 nm) and high reflection for solar background suppression (400-700 nm). I deliberately omit absorption metrics since the user's request focuses on transmittance/reflectance trade-off rather than loss minimization. I use mean (not worst_case) metrics because the user's phrasing '尽可能' (as much as possible) indicates average band performance is the optimization target, not guaranteed minimum/maximum at every wavelength. No angle or polarization constraints are added since the user did not specify incidence conditions.
standard.formula_rationale: The user emphasizes both requirements equally using parallel phrasing ('as completely as possible' for signal, 'as much as possible' for background). Both variables are added positively because the direction for both is maximize. No coefficients are used because the request provides no basis to prioritize signal transmission over background rejection or vice versa, and both metrics are fractions on the same 0–1 scale, making a simple sum the most neutral and defensible choice.
